The Project Implementation Plan is the annual work plan and budget of the National Health Mission. The District Health Society, Sheikhpura prepares its PIP each financial year, which is consolidated by the State Health Society, Bihar and approved by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare through the Record of Proceedings. This portal publishes the approved allocations and guidelines against each FMR budget head so that block programme managers, facility in-charges and citizens can refer to the same source of truth.
